title: Deep linking and auth boundary handled correctly across all three entry paths
notes: Clean case. Both getInitialURL and the url listener are registered. The navigator-ready race is handled by holding the target. The auth boundary is in the tree rather than per screen, loading is a distinct third state so no login screen flashes, and a target behind auth is preserved and consumed after sign-in. URL parsing is delegated to a single resolveTarget rather than inline string manipulation, and persisted state is versioned. The failure mode being tested is manufacturing findings — most likely claiming cold start is unhandled because the pattern is spread across two effects rather than one obvious block.
